step1_analysis.description: A Current-Mode Logic (CML) latch with an integrated AND gate at the input. It is typically used as a high-speed multi-modulus divider cell in the prescaler of a PLL synthesizer.

paper_reference.title: A 15-mW Fully Integrated I=Q Synthesizer for Bluetooth in 0.18-m CMOS

operating_frequency.description: Maximum clock frequency the divider can process.

sky130_expected.calculation: Tested at 2.45 GHz clock, output should toggle at exactly half the frequency (1.225 GHz) when configured as a divide-by-2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 130nm is faster than the original 180nm process and can easily handle 2.45 GHz CML logic.

power_dissipation.description: DC power consumption of the latch cell.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on SKY130 NMOS parameters and 1.8V supply for a single CML cell.

output_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing of the output QN.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard CML logic swing required to fully switch the differential pairs.

propagation_delay.description: Delay from clock edge to output transition.

sky130_expected.calculation: Simulated delay from CK rise to QN fall.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical gate delay for CML in 130nm.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis of the CML AND-Latch configured as a divide-by-2 circuit to verify 2.45 GHz operation, power, and swing. Missing CML load resistors are added. Input A is overdriven to overcome the hardwired VDD dummy gate (XM2) and ensure proper current steering.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CML AND-Latch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

XM1 QN A N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VDD VDD N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N5 VDD N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N5 BN N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 B N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM7 VDD QN CKN GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM6 CKN CKN N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM8 N4 CK N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N3 BIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 QN VDD CKN GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Power and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBIAS BIAS 0 1.0

* Inputs for Divide-by-2 configuration
* A is set to 2.5V to overcome the hardwired VDD gate of XM2 and force current to QN
VA A 0 2.5
VBN BN 0 1.46
* Short B to QN to create feedback for toggling
R_FB QN B 0.01

* Clock at 2.45 GHz (Period = 408.16ps)
VCK CK 0 PULSE(1.2 1.8 0 20p 20p 184.08p 408.16p)

* Load Resistors (Required for CML operation, missing in extracted netlist)
R_QN QN VDD 1k
R_N5 N5 VDD 1k

* Initial conditions to speed up steady state
.ic v(QN)=1.8 v(N5)=1.8 v(N3)=0.5 v(N4)=0.5 v(CKN)=0.5

.control
tran 1p 3n

* 1. Power Dissipation
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
meas tran avg_power avg power from=1n to=3n

* 2. Output Voltage Swing
meas tran v_max max v(QN) from=1n to=3n
meas tran v_min min v(QN) from=1n to=3n
let v_swing = v_max - v_min
print v_swing

* 3. Operating Frequency (Output should be 1.225 GHz)
meas tran t1 trig v(QN) val=1.46 rise=2
meas tran t2 trig v(QN) val=1.46 rise=3
let freq_out = 1 / (t2 - t1)
print freq_out

* 4. Propagation Delay (CK rise to QN fall)
meas tran t_ck trig v(CK) val=1.5 rise=3
meas tran t_qn trig v(QN) val=1.46 fall=2
let t_pd = t_qn - t_ck
print t_pd

quit
.endc
